senses.gloss: argaḍa, m. (= Skt. ˚la, Pali ˚ḷa or ˚la; once in ŚB Mādhy., ŚB K. reading ˚la, see BR), bolt, bar: Mv 〔ii.115.12〕 (read) nivātāni sparśitārgaḍāni (kūṭāgārāṇi), see sparśita; Mvy 〔5581〕; Prāt 〔506.11〕; SP acc. to KN Preface 〔vi〕, in Nep. (Kashgar rec. ˚ṭa).
argalaka (nt.? = Pali aggala), patch (on garments, here sandals): MSV 〔iv.203.11〕.
argalapāśa, m. (= Pali aggaḷa-pāsaka or aggala˚, AMg. aggalapāsaga), receptacle or latch in which the bolt fits, a part of a city gate: Mv 〔i.195.19〕 (prose).
